title: Siman 295
section: The Virtue of Those Who Drew Close to Him

segments.he: לְעִנְיַןשְׁבִירַת תַּאֲווֹת וּמִדּוֹת רָעוֹת לְגַמְרֵי בְּתַכְלִית הַבִּטּוּל שֶׁהִתְפָּאֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה לָזֶה, אָמַר רַבֵּנוּ
segments.en: (5.) I heard in his name that he said: "If we saw a treasure we would certainly run to it and dig and dirty ourselves in mud and mire in order to dig after it and find it. And am I not a treasure of awe of Heaven — and why are they not eager and running after me to receive it?" And they asked him how it is possible to receive it — and he replied: "With the mouth and the heart one must dig and seek" [in Yiddish: "mitn pisk un mitn hartz"] — "with your mouth and with your heart to do it."
